scope: Development calibration of the actual exported meaning-review prompt with user payload captured through the actual library adapt path. Recorded model verdicts will be replayed through the unchanged parser and runtime.
cases: Eight lead-authored controls: four faithful rewrites and four single-defect counterparts, with no style preference ranking.
acceptance: All eight raw verdicts must parse with literal excerpts. Faithful controls should be preserved and faulty controls rejected. Report false acceptance, false rejection, invalid output and runtime fallback separately; no instruction tuning or retries.
stop: Stop after eight fresh native tasks; retain all results.
limits: The captured system/user text is supplied via a native task file, not verified raw-provider role delivery.
Native collaboration does not expose/enforce the reference provider temperature or output-token limit, although the actual runtime request records temperature 0 and maxTokens 1500.
Same Luna alias across controls; this is not a configured-provider benchmark, installed plugin test, personal voice or human comprehension study.
Sources are lead-authored development controls, not independently authored or held-out quality cases.
Exact backend revision, usage and cost not exposed.
